items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: the first man I seen... it was Bunk Johnson. I seen him on my excursion... and I saw him play.

ctx.x: You wouldn't know my band might go there.

No. I didn't never get to see him. I don't mean I wasn't old enough to see him, but I just never, I'll tell you the man I first seen when I was kind of getting on my feet with Trumpet, the first man I seen, I ain't gonna lie, it was Bunk Johnson. I seen him on my excursion pass our home recently, going to Homer, Louisiana, and I went on that excursion and I saw him play. First time. And I didn't ever see Joe Oliver until I went to Chicago.
That's a funny thing, you can live in the same town with people and never hear him.

items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: I didn't know nobody but King Oliver and Bunk Johnson... I went on an excursion one time... then saw him play

ctx.x: Who are some of the older ones?
Well, I didn't know nobody but King Oliver and Bunk Johnson. I never met Buddy Bowling.
Edward Clem, did you meet him?
